reviewFindings: A malformed-UTF-8 or per-file I/O failure is now isolated into a bounded structured DiscoveryError and does not erase unrelated valid skill records. The failing file itself is omitted from repository_skill authority.
Raw OSError prose and malformed file content are not copied into the structured error reason. A title decode failure may retain the already-computed exact byte SHA only as diagnostic evidence.

The first implementation changed discoveryErrors from strings to objects while leaving the outer report schema at v1. Code-first review rejected that silent contract mutation; the source now uses try-forever-skill-provenance.v2 and represents repository/identity failures in the same structured envelope.
Strict mode still treats any discovery error as failure. Isolation means the report completes; it does not convert a wounded skill into success.

The Warm Wall gained one materially distinct FILE FAULT ISOLATED state while preserving radio semantics, roving keyboard navigation, minimum touch sizing, non-color state tokens, one live detail surface, and no autoplay/Christmas blink.

Fresh Home Center readback rejects Command Center Codex jobs/workers as a permanently retired capability. The prior 0300 queued deep-detail ticket state is therefore historical evidence only and is not promoted as a current execution lane or current queue state.

Independent next wound: markdown_title still has no explicit per-line/title resource budget. A valid UTF-8 SKILL.md with an enormous first line can consume disproportionate memory/report space even though malformed/unreadable files are now isolated. Keep this open for a later non-P0 pulse.
